messages:
maria.s: Heads up — around 20:40 we started seeing mTLS handshake failures from eu-west services after the keystore RBAC change. Errors spike ~4x. :rotating_light:
jon_r: Which services are failing? ingress proxy or internal sidecars?
maria.s: Primarily ingress-proxy -> model-runtime and service-to-service calls between runtime replicas. Logs show KMS decrypt denies, then handshake abort.
jon_r: can you paste a log snippet?
maria.s: ```
2026-03-22T20:40:12Z ingress-proxy[conn-1423] ERROR: tls_handshake_failed: state=client_hello, err=decryption_failed, reason="KMS:AccessDenied" request_id=abcd-1234
2026-03-22T20:40:13Z runtime[instance-5] WARN: kv-cache-miss, using short-lived cert fallback; fallback_used=true
```
kevin_oncall: ok that looks like the RBAC clip we pushed last night. Which IAM role got tightened?
maria.s: We removed kms:Decrypt for role svc-keystore-reader in eu-west as part of least-privilege cleanup. Seems the rotator agent still relies on that role for ephemeral key unwraps during cert churn.
jon_r: audit-bot: any correlated KMS audit logs for the denies?
audit-bot: https://internal-logs/kms?query=AccessDenied+Decrypt+1754042020 — 37 hits across eu-west-1 from 20:38-20:43. Initiator: svc-keystore-reader@redwood-prod.
kevin_oncall: Recommended immediate mitigation: re-grant kms:Decrypt to svc-keystore-reader for eu-west (temp), then coordinate a safer rule. Can we do a fast canary for 10% of hostgroups?
maria.s: Yes — canary rollback for that role is lowest blast radius. Also adding a 5m cached certificate fallback on proxy side should avoid full outage while we sort perms.
jon_r: Created an infra-incident runbook entry: `ROLLBACK-RBAC-KESTORE` and a deploy blocker. I'll open a PR with the role add + expiry tag.
kevin_oncall: Also we discovered an observability blindspot — session-ticket logging wasn't shipped to central logs in ap-south/eu-west due to a missing aggregator config. We need to patch that so next time we can trace which tenant got impacted.
maria.s: Agreed. Action items: 1) jon re-add kms:Decrypt to svc-keystore-reader (eu-west) with an expiration tag. 2) kevin validate proxy 5m cert cache rollout. 3) maria to add session-ticket telemetry PR and add audit-alert rule for KMS AccessDenied spikes.
jon_r: On it, ETA 15m.
kevin_oncall: i'll verify metrics/dashboards once role is patched. :thumbsup:
maria.s: thanks — we'll follow up in postmortem with root cause & longer-term change: rotator should have fallback principal and preflight permission check before we cut RBAC.
jon_r: noted.
kevin_oncall: marking this thread for incident follow-up.
